'''The Booster Pack''' is a podcast about the history and design of collectible and trading card games, produced by CCG History (Rands Lincoln) and released on the YouTube channel The Booster Pack Network and as audio through Buzzsprout, 2020–2024.<ref name="yt-UhHLkZCiqcw" /><ref name="bz28">[https://theboosterpack.buzzsprout.com/1692574/episodes/10935581-booster-pack-throwback-28-decipher-s-star-wars-ccg-with-designer-tom-braunlich Booster Pack Throwback #28: Decipher's Star Wars CCG with designer Tom Braunlich], The Booster Pack (Buzzsprout).</ref> Its main series is long-form interviews with card game designers and publishers, later branded ''Booster Pack Throwback''; side series include ''Rare Slot'', ''Singles'', ''TCG Design Theory'' and the monthly news show ''TCG Scoops''. In August 2023 the channel announced changes to its content; its last episode, ''TCG Design Theory'' #14, was released in February 2024.<ref name="yt-WipKDij91pw" /><ref name="yt-KZxOX8rga7k" />

== SWCCG-related episodes ==

Several episodes are primary sources for the history of Decipher and the Star Wars CCG:
* '''#03''' – [[Jason Robinette]], a Decipher playtester, on Conan CCG, Ophidian 2350, Myths & Legends and the Star Wars CCG.<ref name="yt-CcACWhnF4F4" />
* '''#04''' – [[Jason Winter]] on Fullmetal Alchemist TCG, 24 TCG and Star Trek CCG.<ref name="yt-9cFtbAxU9UY" />
* '''#07''' and '''#08''' – [[Chuck Kallenbach]], in two parts: Star Wars CCG, Star Trek and The Lord of the Rings TCG; then .hack//ENEMY, [[WARS TCG]] and Battlestar Galactica CCG.<ref name="yt-BvVRth2CIwQ" /><ref name="yt-1uupsqSIY9U" />
* '''Rare Slot #02''' – "The Lost CCGs of Decipher".<ref name="yt-tyxRQgXVYEU" />
* '''Singles #02''' – the future of licensed CCGs, including the Star Wars and Star Trek games.<ref name="yt-co_mgKQkHsY" />
* '''#27''' and '''#28''' – [[Tom Braunlich]] on the making of the Star Trek CCG and the Star Wars CCG (#28, 24 August 2022, about 1 hour 19 minutes).<ref name="yt-zK_94pNOPTU" /><ref name="yt-AXdIdJwnjgc" /><ref name="bz28">[https://theboosterpack.buzzsprout.com/1692574/episodes/10935581-booster-pack-throwback-28-decipher-s-star-wars-ccg-with-designer-tom-braunlich Booster Pack Throwback #28: Decipher's Star Wars CCG with designer Tom Braunlich], The Booster Pack (Buzzsprout).</ref>
* '''TCG Design Theory #09''' – Chuck Kallenbach on designing physical versus digital TCGs.<ref name="yt-arsY0ZeeP-o" />
